name: fz519_volt_switch_sub
purpose: Volt Switch into a Substitute (issue 519): Rotom, p2b, breaks Altaria's Substitute with Volt Switch (step 8); runMoveEffects' selfSwitch runs for the null target (sim/battle-actions.ts:1290-1296, 1311-1312), so Rotom switches out (step 9). A battle of the differential fuzzing of issue 396 (free random sets, fz_3_38), cut after its step 9: adopted as a regression fixture. The choices and the seed are those of the campaign; the trace is recorded with the pinned Showdown (b2cb775).
